name: Baselane
positioning: Banking and bookkeeping in one product — a separate account per property, without opening ten accounts at a bank.
description: Baselane provides landlord banking with virtual accounts per property, rent collection, automated bookkeeping against a real estate chart of accounts, and reporting. It combines the deposit account and the accounting layer that would normally be two vendors.
real_estate_use: Commingling funds across properties is the classic small-landlord accounting failure, and the usual fix — a bank account per property — is administratively painful. Virtual accounts give the same separation with one relationship, and because the money movement and the bookkeeping share a system, categorisation is automatic rather than reconciled later.
features: Landlord banking with virtual accounts per property or unit
Rent collection by ACH and card with automatic matching
Automated bookkeeping to a real estate chart of accounts
Cash flow and tax reporting per property
Rent analysis and landlord loan options

use_cases.job: Keep funds separated per property without opening an account for each one
Have rent, expenses and books reconcile automatically instead of monthly
